questionEnglish: How many centimeters of thin soil layer formation can take thousands of years according to the textbook?

questionEnglish: Which of the following elements are mixed together to form the structure of soil?
questionOdia: ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ସମସ୍ତ ଉପାଦାନର ମିଶ୍ରଣରେ ମୃତ୍ତିକା ସଠିକ୍ ଭାବରେ ଗଠିତ ହୋଇଥାଏ?

answer: ବାଲି, ମାଟି ବା କର୍ଦ୍ଦମ, ପଟୁମାଟି ଏବଂ ଜୈବାଂଶ
explanation: ମୃତ୍ତିକା ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ବାଲି (Sand), ମାଟି ବା କର୍ଦ୍ଦମ (Clay), ପଟୁମାଟି (Silt) ଓ ଜୈବାଂଶର ମିଶ୍ରଣରେ ଗଠିତ ହୋଇଥାଏ।

questionEnglish: Which environmental factor listed in the box is the primary determinant of soil formation?

questionEnglish: Which factor controls the depth and thickness of the soil layer over a geographical region?

questionEnglish: Based on the physical and chemical properties, how many main types of characteristics are found in soil?

questionEnglish: What are the two major classifications of soil based on its place of origin and relocation?

questionEnglish: What is the soil called that remains at its place of origin after weathering of parent rocks?
questionOdia: ଚୂର୍ଣ୍ଣୀଭବନ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ପରେ ଶିଳା ସୂକ୍ଷ୍ମ ରେଣୁରେ ପରିଣତ ହୋଇ ସେହି ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଜମି ରହିଲେ ତାହାକୁ କେଉଁ ମୃତ୍ତିକା କୁହାଯାଏ?

questionEnglish: What name is given to soil that is transported by natural agents like rivers, glaciers, and wind to other regions?
questionOdia: ନଦୀ, ବାୟୁ ଏବଂ ହିମବାହ ପରି ପ୍ରାକୃତିକ ସଂବାହକ ଦ୍ଵାରା ଅନ୍ୟ ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ପ୍ରବାହିତ ହୋଇ ସଞ୍ଚିତ ହେଉଥିବା ମୃତ୍ତିକାକୁ କେଉଁ ମୃତ୍ତିକା କୁହାଯାଏ?

questionEnglish: In which climatic regions do we generally find highly acidic soils due to heavy rainfall washing away soluble bases?
questionOdia: ଅତ୍ୟଧିକ ବୃଷ୍ଟିପାତ ଯୋଗୁଁ କ୍ଷାରୀୟ ପଦାର୍ଥ ଧୋଇଯାଇ କେଉଁ ଜଳବାୟୁ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ଅମ୍ଳୀୟ ମୃତ୍ତିକା ସୃଷ୍ଟି ହୋଇଥାଏ?

questionEnglish: What is the specific soil type called that develops in hot and humid conditions, rich in iron and aluminum, known as Pedalfer?
questionOdia: ଆଦ୍ର ଜଳବାୟୁ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ଲୌହ ଓ ଆଲୁମିନିୟମ୍ ଯୁକ୍ତ ସୃଷ୍ଟି ହେଉଥିବା ମୃତ୍ତିକାକୁ କେଉଁ ଶ୍ରେଣୀଭୁକ୍ତ କରାଯାଇଛି?

questionEnglish: Which soil category is characterized by high calcium accumulation, typically found in arid and semi-arid regions?

questionEnglish: Which organization in India (ICAR) has classified Indian soils into different major categories based on characteristics?

questionEnglish: According to the ICAR classification mentioned, into how many major soil types is Indian soil divided?

questionEnglish: Which soil type occupies the largest area in India and is considered the most widespread and fertile?

questionEnglish: What percentage of India's total geographical area is covered by Alluvial soil as mentioned in Page 17?

questionEnglish: Which of the following river valleys in North India is completely formed by rich alluvial deposition?

questionEnglish: What are the new, younger alluvial deposits in the floodplains locally called?
